description: The My-Mind Countdown ⌛ Visual adds a sense of time, urgency, and focus to your Power BI 📊 dashboards. Transform static reports into dynamic, real-time experiences that engage users and highlight the moments that truly matter — whether it’s the countdown to a product launch, quarter-end target, or the start of a new fiscal year. 🚀 Bring Time to Life in Your Dashboards The My-Mind Countdown Visual provides two fully interactive display modes: Clock Mode – show the current date and time, synchronized with each viewer’s local timezone or your dataset’s UTC refresh time. Countdown Mode – display the remaining time until any selected event or date field in your data model. Watch years, months, days, hours, and minutes tick down in real time. With smooth transitions and precise calculations, your reports feel alive and immediately relevant. 🎨 Design Freedom Create visually stunning countdowns that match your organization’s brand or your Power BI theme. Gradient or solid color backgrounds Rounded or sharp corners Border and edge highlighting Adjustable opacity for overlay integration Font and size customization with theme awareness Light / dark mode adaptation Every visual can be configured directly from the Format pane, allowing authors to adjust layout, alignment, and typography without writing code. 📅 Event-Driven Insights Empower business users with event-centric dashboards.…
